enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Improved Cursespewing: On Vorpal Hit: Your enemy is cursed with a -4 morale penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. This painful curse also causes the victim to take 2d6 damage every two seconds for a duration of twelve seconds. Additional vorpal strikes while the curse is active will extend the duration by another twelve seconds.
Potency +52: Passive: +52 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Nullification +78: Passive: +78 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Necromancy Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
